definitions.gloss: young nobleman; elegant, refined young man
definitions.explanation: Originally a young man of noble birth; now mostly used, often in the media, for a handsome young man with graceful, well-bred manners, especially an athlete or performer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{貴公子|きこうし}だ。
{貴公子|きこうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: His princely smile makes him popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{端正|たんせい}→端正：14887_tansei⟧な⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧な⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦フィギュア→フィギュア：07081_figyua⟧⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貴公子|きこうし}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: With his fine features and elegant skating, he was called "the prince of figure skating".

notes:
Common as a nickname in sports and entertainment: 〜⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貴公子|きこうし} (the prince of ~). The image is gentle and refined rather than rugged.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{王子|おうじ}→王子：01904_ouji⟧: prince — also used as a nickname (⟦ハンカチ→ハンカチ：02937_hankachi⟧⟦{王子|おうじ}→王子：01904_ouji⟧), more playful
- {御曹司|おんぞうし}: son of a wealthy or distinguished family — about family background, not looks
